The Cordana Leaf Spot reference shows large, irregular dark brown/black lesions on a green banana leaf — very similar in color and pattern to the test image, but with less distinct halo definition.

The orange/reddish halo around the dark center in the test image is actually a strong feature. This halo pattern (dark center + yellowish-orange border) is characteristic of **Cordana Leaf Spot**, where the lesion transitions from dark necrotic tissue to the surrounding chlorotic zone.

The single, large, oval dark lesion with the distinct halo border on a banana leaf fits Cordana Leaf Spot well. Yellow and Black Sigatoka typically presents with multiple smaller streaky spots with more diffuse yellow halos rather than this isolated, high-contrast single lesion.
